name: utsavair
description: UtsavAir — festival corridor desk. Pooled group allotment for flights and coaches on India's highest-surge festival routes.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && npm run prerender
scripts.prerender: vite build --ssr scripts/prerender.tsx --outDir dist-ssr --logLevel warn && node dist-ssr/prerender.js
scripts.verify: tsc --noEmit && vite build --ssr scripts/ssr-check.tsx --outDir dist-ssr --logLevel warn && node dist-ssr/ssr-check.js
scripts.audit: vite build --ssr scripts/dom-check.tsx --outDir dist-ssr --logLevel warn && node dist-ssr/dom-check.js
